title: One write-outside-the-checkout guard for every session, which allows notes folders
why: Your ask (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh26MuXHQwVQFmfKrqbe6bgD9): Banchi's guard refused a write to the Claude app's side-session notes folder (~/Library/Application Support/Claude-Work/side-session-notes/), while claude-settings' own rule covers too little.
note: Today claude-settings' worktree-home rule (an agent outside its home tree must stop) covers only isolated subagents, and only writes into the same clone; it skips the top-level session and sessions started in .claude/worktrees/. Banchi's scripts/guard-shell.py clause 2 (tree) covers every session but refuses any path outside the checkout except ~/.claude, /dev and a non-repo temp folder, so it refuses harmless notes folders. Next cloud lane (claude-settings part): the guard refuses a write into a different checkout of the same clone (the 2026-09-06 incident) for every session, and allows paths in no checkout; red first on a top-level session writing into a sibling checkout. Banchi part, after it: add tree to GUARD_SHELL_SKIP for Claude Code (Codex keeps its copy); the stopgap adds the notes folder to _sanctioned_outside (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh28TR1H4ucZ5AZvycb7QHvYu); both change another repo, so they need your plan check first. Checked: claude-settings main 34dc6a9, banchi main dfcde22. Port: the Banchi part is the port. Placed ahead of c107 (triage, Oct 28): the claude-settings part needs no answer and every session hits the gap. Doing: lane started Oct 28 01:20 CDT (orchestrator, after batch 2).
